# tfcensus audit

audit checks the S3 buckets and DynamoDB lock tables that hold the units' state against a
list of checks: versioning, encryption, public access, lock table settings and stale locks.
audit backend runs them.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus audit <command>
```

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus audit backend
tfcensus audit backend --fail-on high --out sarif=audit.sarif
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [tfcensus audit backend](/cli/audit/backend) | Check state buckets, lock tables and the fleet of states |
